description: Visual style specification for Phase 1 raid base-map assets.
principles: The base raid view is a flat top-down exploration map, not an angled interior room scene.
Teams should read as dots or lightweight markers first, with richer detail deferred to focus mode.
Tiles, fog, features, and enemy indicators should optimize for exploration readability over environmental illusion.
Raid base-map assets must not inherit HQ isometric room-box geometry.
notes: Use clear top-down tile edges, junctions, chambers, and paths that remain legible under fog-of-war.
Map features should function as top-down markers, not room props placed in perspective.
Enemy and team visuals should stay abstract at base zoom and become richer only in focus overlays.
Do not build raid base tiles as isometric rooms or cutaway interiors.
